name: translit
description:
Letters of one alphabet written in the other.

The other chars stay.

to: "en" — «Щука жёлтая» → «Schuka zheltaya», a word in capitals stays in capitals («ЖУК» → «ZHUK»); "ru" — by letter groups, «Yandex» → «Яндекс», «Jeep» → «Джееп», «ob'em» → «обэм»: shch is щ, ts is ц, yy is ый («krasnyy» → «красный»), y after a vowel and before no vowel is й («Moy» → «Мой», «dayte» → «дайте»); a word in capitals is read by the groups of small letters and stays in capitals («ZHUK» → «ЖУК»). ь and ъ are dropped in "en" and е and ё both give e, so "ru" cannot bring them back («den» → «ден»).

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" translit en write -
-> kupit divan
Example: semkit read --text "Yandex" translit ru write -
-> Яндекс

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.
